allow_instructions: Allow read and write of normal project source, tests, docs, and config files inside this repository workspace.
Allow npm and npx scripts for install, lint, format, typecheck, build, and test inside this repository.
Allow git status, git diff, git log, git show, git add, git commit, and creating or switching feature branches inside this repository.
Allow ordinary non-force git push of the current feature branch to origin when pushing or opening a PR.
Allow GitHub CLI commands that only create or view pull requests and checks: gh pr create, gh pr view, gh pr list, gh pr checks, gh pr diff.
Allow ordinary shell commands scoped to this workspace for local development and agent factory stages.
block_instructions: Every command that merges a pull request should go through approval first, including gh pr merge and any GitHub API or CLI equivalent that merges a PR.
Every git force push should go through approval first, including git push --force, git push -f, git push --force-with-lease, and force pushes to main, master, or story branches.
Every hard reset or destructive working-tree wipe should go through approval first, including git reset --hard and git clean -fd.
Every change to git configuration or hooks should go through approval first, including git config, editing .git/config, and creating or modifying files under .git/hooks.
Every attempt to delete or corrupt the .git directory should go through approval first.
Every command that publishes packages (npm publish), creates releases (gh release), sets secrets (gh secret), or changes repo/org settings should go through approval first.
Every command that deploys to production or mutates cloud infrastructure should go through approval first.
Every command that reads or exfiltrates secrets, .env files, credentials, SSH keys, or tokens outside ordinary local tooling should go through approval first.
